resources.why: UK retailer, same buyer, replaced Segment's audiences. Audience launch went from 2 weeks to 1 day.
EMEA retailer that kept Segment. Their Head of Data has been through a GDPR review and can talk to Tom directly.
Zero customer data copies outside the EU warehouse. Send to legal before they ask.
Say this before Thursday, then prove it by building an audience live on their loyalty model.

email.subject: Before Thursday: two retailers that had your questions

paragraphs.text: Thanks for Monday. You raised three things, and I'd like to answer them before the demo.

Waiting on the data team for every audience. Fernhill Grocers in Manchester had the same two-week queue. After their data team modeled the loyalty data, the CRM team started launching audiences in a day.
Adding a tool next to Segment. You'd keep Segment for tracking. Vasa Outdoor runs both: Segment collects events, and Hightouch builds audiences on what's already in Snowflake.

Keeping data in your EU region. No customer data left Vasa's EU warehouse, and their Head of Data has been through the GDPR review with us. Tom, I can set up a 30-minute call with them this week if that helps.
On Thursday Sam will build an audience live on your loyalty model, with no ticket to the data team.

paragraphs.text: Thanks for Monday. On your question about adding a tool next to Segment: you'd keep it. Vasa Outdoor uses Segment to collect events and Hightouch to build audiences on their Snowflake data.
